visual_concept: A solitary monolithic SmartAccount—sculpted as a dense obsidian prism with an optical glass interior—anchored in an expansive void. From its internal chamber, a precision credit conduit routes through a dedicated aperture toward an external Blend b-token module. The module feeds back layered strata of b-token receipt mass directly into the SmartAccount's sealed perimeter, stacking automated leverage within its isolated boundary while adjacent account sandboxes remain completely unaffected.

assets.critique: The asset is completely dominated by infographic typography, formulas, and ticker symbols, directly violating the zero-text rule. Visually, it relies on generic neon magenta/cyan crypto glows and depicts an abstract 10x leverage funnel rather than Vanna's actual SmartAccount isolation or risk thresholds described in the post.
assets.fix: Remove all typography, text labels, and UI headers. Replace the abstract leverage megaphone with an isolated, sealed modular SmartAccount chamber operating alongside Blend b-token liquidity routing rendered in matte, obsidian materials.

assets.mechanism_named: SmartAccount isolated storage vs fragile shared-pool systemic risk
assets.critique: A strong, restrained visual contrast that executes the core thesis. The left panel shows a precarious, tape-bound ruler scaffolding balancing over an open pit (evoking fragile EVM shared pools prone to cascading liquidations), while the right panel presents a precision-machined, discrete isolation vault on an obsidian plinth protecting value. No text or crypto slop.

Features a prominent glowing purple Bitcoin coin prop enclosed in a sci-fi vault. Vanna is composable credit infrastructure on Stellar Soroban testnet, not a Bitcoin vault product. Using the Bitcoin glyph breaks brand identity, conveys zero Vanna mechanism, and uses prohibited coin prop tropes.
assets.fix: Replace the Bitcoin coin prop with an optical, non-monetary asset representation (such as an optical glass token or modular cell representing isolated SmartAccount state) and eliminate the neon aura in favor of controlled edge lighting on dark matte surfaces.
